duration: Dates listed this fall (no year printed; the weekdays match 2026): Kids' Night Out on Fridays, Nov 20 to Dec 18, 5:30 to 9:00 p.m. Santa's Workshop on Dec 1, 3, 6, 8, 10, 13, 15, 17 and 20.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The district can sign off on volunteer hours for school.
name: Volunteer Programs and Events (ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Help run park district events. Examples are Kids' Night Out (climbing, crafts and games) and Santa's Workshop (greeting families, photos, goody bags). There are also Nature Champion volunteer days. You can get proof of your hours for school.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 and up can volunteer on their own. Kids' Night Out and Santa's Workshop are open at age 14 (high school freshman). Anyone 14 or younger who is not in those roles needs a parent or guardian with them. BINGO volunteers must be 18.
deadline_text: Apply at least two weeks before the date you want to volunteer. Santa's Workshop runs December 1 to 20 and Kids' Night Out runs November 20 to December 18 (no year printed on the page; weekdays match 2026).
how_to_apply: Fill out the Student Application (17 and under) and approve a DCFS background check, at least two weeks ahead. Then email Becca (address on the Programs volunteer page) to sign up for a program. You cannot just show up, except at Nature Champion days.
notes: Volunteer hours can be confirmed by email, a signed letter or a school form.
